title: Conveyancing Assistant
description:
Conveyancing Assistant
£28,000 - £35,000 per annum, DOE
Chelmsford, Essex
Monday-Friday, 9am-5pm

This is a fantastic opportunity for an individual with experience in residential conveyancing who is comfortable handling a broad range of matters while delivering outstanding support to both clients and legal professionals.

As a valued member of the team, you will assist with property transactions from the initial instruction through to final completion, helping to ensure a smooth, professional and customer-focused experience at every stage.

Your responsibilities will include, but are not limited to:
- Providing support across a diverse portfolio of residential conveyancing files.

- Drafting, preparing and checking legal documents and correspondence.
- Requesting, analysing and processing property searches and related documentation.
- Supporting the exchange of contracts and completion of transactions.
- Handling post-completion administration and compliance requirements.
- Maintaining accurate records and updating case management systems.
- Tracking important milestones and ensuring deadlines are met.
- Delivering a high standard of client care and providing regular progress updates.
- Working closely with colleagues across the Property department to facilitate efficient transaction progression.

My client is looking for someone who:
- Have proven experience within a residential conveyancing environment.
- Possess a strong understanding of the conveyancing process from inception through to completion.
- Be confident communicating directly with clients and industry professionals.
- Demonstrate excellent organisational skills and the ability to juggle multiple priorities.
- Have a meticulous approach and strong attention to detail.
- Communicate effectively and professionally, both verbally and in writing.
- Show initiative, work autonomously when required and contribute positively as part of a team.
- Be committed to delivering an exceptional client experience.
- Have experience using legal case management software; familiarity with LEAP would be beneficial but is not essential.

title: Immigration Paralegal
company: GEMINI RECRUITMENT SERVICES LTD - Agency - Permanent
description:
Role: Immigration Paralegals (x 2) Wethersfield IRC, Braintree, Essex

Gemini Recruitment are currently partnering with a large and established law firm. Our client serves corporate entities and private individuals in over 25 practice areas from offices throughout London and across England and Wales. Our client's accomplishments are acknowledged and recommended in The Legal 500 and Chambers and Partners, as a top tier firm.

Our client holds the Investors in People Gold Accreditation Quality Standard Mark and is LEXCEL, Cyber Essentials Plus and ISO accredited and regulated by the Solicitors Regulation Authority.

About the Role:

A leading law firm is seeking dedicated Immigration Paralegals / Caseworkers to join its highly regarded Immigration Department. This is an excellent opportunity to work within a recognised legal practice with a strong reputation for delivering high-quality immigration and asylum services.

The successful candidates will be based at Wethersfield IRC, providing support on a wide range of immigration matters, including both publicly funded and private client work.

Based in Wethersfield, Braintree, Essex, this role offers the opportunity to be part of a highly regarded Immigration team, with periodic attendance at the firm's London City office (approximately once every fortnight) for mentoring, training, and collaborative working.

Immigration Department Background:

Our client's Immigration lawyers have an established reputation in acting for high net worth individuals, new and established business men and women, and innovative and skilled individuals under the Tier 1 visa categories. The department has a number of highly skilled lawyers who have trained as barristers, and undertake complex appeal cases up to the Court of Appeal and the Supreme Court.

The department offers a wide range of services to European Economic Area (EEA) and non-EEA individuals and families wishing to enter, remain, or settle in the UK.

In addition, our client's Immigration department is renowned for their extensive experience in Asylum claims and challenging human rights violations for unaccompanied minors and victims of torture, trafficking, and domestic abuse. In these cases, our client's practitioners are committed to assisting no matter their individual client's circumstance.

Main Duties and Responsibilities:
- Report directly to Department Director
- Professional pro-active approach, strong client care skills and a sensitive and sympathetic understanding of clients' needs
- Assisting with casework including dealing with a range of Immigration matters (LAA Funded and Private client work) as well as undertaking your own advocacy
- Attending clients, taking instructions and preparing cases
- Dealing with correspondence
- Preparing and managing funding applications to the Legal Aid Agency,
- Preparing draft documents including witness statements and processing evidence
- Preparing applications to meet Home Office requirements (incl drafting application forms, index of documents and letters of representations)
- Attending conferences and court
- Maintaining accurate time costing procedures
- Implementing any recommendations made by your supervisor following monthly file reviews ensuring that these are dealt with promptly
- Ensuring compliance with file management.

Key Skills Required:
- Demonstrate passion and experience in a broad range of publicly funded Immigration Law
- A strong academic background with a Law degree
- Possess IAAS Level 1 or 2 accreditation, or demonstrate a willingness to undertake and achieve accreditation.
- Legal experience as an Immigration Paralegal/Advisor
- Clear understanding and application of Immigration Laws
- Business acumen and the ability to market the Company
- Excellent communications skills to work effectively with all types of people
- Excellent analytical and organisational skills and ability to use own initiative but know when to seek guidance
- Committed team player, self -motivated and professional
- Excellent IT Skills -familiar with Microsoft Office applications and document management skills

This list is not exhaustive and there may be other duties as reasonably required.

The company is committed to Equal Opportunities and embraces diversity and inclusivity of its staff and strives to ensure that their workforce reflects the diversity of the communities they serve.

Equality and Diversity:

The firm is committed to equal opportunities and values diversity and inclusion. Applications are welcomed from all suitably qualified candidates regardless of background.

About Gemini Recruitment:

Gemini Recruitment is a specialist legal recruitment agency focusing on the placement of Solicitors, Legal Executives, Trainee Solicitors, Paralegals, and Legal Support Staff throughout the UK legal market.

The recruitment process will comply with GDPR and all applicable legislation. Background checks, including DBS checks, may be undertaken to assess eligibility and suitability for the role.

Apply Now:

If you are looking to further your career within a respected and supportive legal practice committed to developing future legal professionals, we would like to hear from you.

Apply today to be considered for this exciting Immigration Paralegal opportunity based at Wethersfield IRC, near Braintree Essex.
